Initial alpha release of minelabs.

Dependencies:

- Minecraft version: 1.19.2
- Fabric loader version (select via [installer](https://fabricmc.net/use/installer/)): 0.14.9
- [Fabric-API](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/fabric-api) version: 0.62

This marks the first release version.
Webite ([link](minelabs.be))

Dependencies:
- Fabric-API [link](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/fabric-api) version 0.62 or higher

Content:
- Subatomic particles
- Subatomic dimension (salt block portal)
- Elementary particles
- Laser Tool (Atom generating)
- Atoms (36 implemented)
- Bohr Plate (atom crafting)
- Lewis Crafting Table (LCT, molecule crafting)
- _Ionic Crafting Table (ICT, molecule crafting)_
- Electric Field (field sensor, electrons, protons)
- Molecules (gasses/fluids/solids, dusts) throwable or placeable
- Lab Blocks (sink/drawer/cabin/full block/mircoscope/tuberack)
- Lab Coat and Safety Glasses



- Entropy Creeper
